title: The Prestige: Benchmarking Cognitive Visual Reasoning using Magic Tricks
abstract: arXiv:2610.38103v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce The Prestige, a video understanding benchmark that probes cognitive visual reasoning through professional magic performances, where deliberate misdirection challenges models to track events and explain unexpected outcomes. The benchmark comprises open-ended questions ranging from temporal and causal understanding to robustness against adversarial questions. Evaluation of leading open-source and proprietary VLMs reveals a substantial gap between even the strongest model and human performance. We also find systematic discrepancies between human and automated grading and identify recurring model failure modes. Ablations further show that models can select correct multiple-choice answers even when they fail to generate correct explanations independently, motivating further investigations into question formats. translated_title: 《致命魔术：利用魔术表演对认知视觉推理进行基准测试》
translated_abstract: 我们推出了 The Prestige，这是一个视频理解基准，通过专业魔术表演来探测认知视觉推理能力，其中魔术师刻意制造的误导会挑战模型追踪事件并解释意外结果的能力。该基准包含开放式问题，涵盖从时间与因果理解到对抗对抗性问题的鲁棒性等多个方面。对领先的开源及专有视觉语言模型的评估显示，即使是最强的模型与人类表现之间也存在显著差距。我们还发现了人类评分与自动化评分之间的系统性差异，并识别出模型反复出现的失败模式。消融实验进一步表明，即使模型无法独立生成正确的解释，它们也能够选出正确的多项选择答案，这激发了对问题形式进行更深入研究的动机。这些发现共同凸显了视觉语言模型在推理及其评估方面的局限性，强调了需要更多……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个利用专业魔术表演中刻意误导来测试视觉语言模型认知视觉推理能力的基准，揭示了最强模型与人类表现之间的巨大差距以及现有模型推理与评估方法的局限性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces The Prestige, a video benchmark using professional magic tricks with deliberate misdirection to test VLMs' cognitive visual reasoning, revealing a substantial gap between even the strongest models and human performance and exposing limitations in both model reasoning and its evaluation.
